content: Amazon’s October Prime Day has effectively chopped off Apple’s June price increases. Usually $1,299, the 13-inch MacBook Air with the M5 chip and 512GB of storage is on sale for $1,099 at Amazon. That’s a more palatable price for a machine that’s significantly faster than Apple’s $699 MacBook Neo. The 15-inch version, also with 512GB of storage, is $1,299 at Amazon (was $1,499). In addition to the larger screen, it has two additional speakers, for a total of six, and two additional GPU cores for better overall graphical performance. [Product: Apple MacBook Air (M5) | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GR1JTFP8/ref=fs_a_mbt2_us4?th=1&tag=theverge02-20, https://www.amazon.com/Apple-2026-MacBook-15-inch-Laptop/dp/B0GR114BV7?th=1&tag=theverge02-20] The latest update to Apple’s midrange laptop includes a noticeable improvement to the speed of both the processor and storage. Even without flashy new features compared to the last-gen model, it’s still one of our favorite laptops, thanks to its long battery life, bright screen, and excellent speakers. Read our Apple MacBook Air (2026, M5) review.
chineseTitle: MacBook Air M5 几个月来首次降价 200 美元
chineseSummary: 亚马逊的 10 月 Prime Day 有效地阻止了苹果 6 月的涨价。通常售价为 1,299 美元的配备 M5 芯片和 512GB 存储空间的 13 英寸 MacBook Air 在亚马逊的售价为 1,099 美元。对于一台比苹果 699 美元的 MacBook Neo 快得多的机器来说，这个价格更让人接受。 15 英寸版本，同样配备 512GB [...]
chineseContent: 亚马逊的 10 月 Prime Day 有效地阻止了苹果 6 月的涨价。通常售价为 1,299 美元的配备 M5 芯片和 512GB 存储空间的 13 英寸 MacBook Air 在亚马逊的售价为 1,099 美元。对于一台比苹果 699 美元的 MacBook Neo 快得多的机器来说，这个价格更让人接受。 15 英寸版本也配备 512GB 存储空间，亚马逊售价 1,299 美元（原价 1,499 美元）。除了更大的屏幕之外，它还额外配备了两个扬声器（总共六个），以及两个额外的 GPU 核心，以实现更好的整体图形性能。 [产品：苹果 MacBook Air (M5) | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GR1JTFP8/ref=fs_a_mbt2_us4?th=1&tag=theverge02-20，https://www.amazon.com/Apple-2026-MacBook-15-inch-Laptop/dp/B0GR114BV7?th=1&tag=theverge02-20]苹果中端笔记本电脑的最新更新包括处理器和存储的速度显着提高。即使与上一代型号相比没有华丽的新功能，它仍然是我们最喜欢的笔记本电脑之一，这要归功于其较长的电池寿命、明亮的屏幕和出色的扬声器。阅读我们的 Apple MacBook Air（2026，M5）评论。
